intro: Kolkar Leaders begins a campaign led by the orc Regthar Deathgate to crush rising centaur warlords in the Barrens. The nomadic Kolkar have plagued the tauren for generations, but newly emerged chieftains are organizing their disorganized bands into a genuine military threat. Regthar tasks champions of the Horde with cutting down Barak Kodobane at the Forgotten Pools before his influence can spread.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The centaurs have plagued the Tauren for years. And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat. Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them. Rallying them.
To preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.
Bring me the head of Barak Kodobane. He camps near the Forgotten Pools to the north.
Defeat him, then return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Do you have Barak's Head for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. The centaur are low, brutish creatures, but a few have the wit and vision to lead. And those are the most dangerous.
Barak was such a centaur. It is good that he is dead.
